notes.title: Dive into Over The Alps: 50% Off in the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
Attention, Agents! As the Holidays hit, it’s time to switch off from work and school, and relax into some well-deserved time-off playing great video games! The Steam Winter Sale is on from the 22nd of December through to the 5th of January, and here at Stave Studios, we want to help celebrate the season with you, which is why [b][i]Over The Alps[/i] will be 50% off[/b] during the sale; [b]our largest discount yet![/b]

Players looking to dive into a world of espionage in [i]Over The Alps[/i] will find plenty to love, as we’ve worked diligently over 2020 to bring new content and updates to the game!

[list]
[*] In June, we added [b][i]King of the Mountain[/i][/b], a free update that doubles the length of the game with an intriguing second story, set a year before the events of the core experience. In [i]King of the Mountain[/i], players will take the role of Annie Taylor, a British spy called away from Paris to attend the Swiss Grand Prix to help tackle enemy Nazi agents and other shady happenings.

[*] [b][i]A Test of Character[/i][/b], a major technical update included with [i]Over The Alps[/i] free of charge, includes more than 10,000 words of original written content, an updated Clues system, and the brand new Complications feature; short stories that will test which stamps you’ve opted for throughout the game, and add additional story branches to the game. 
[/list]

With already so much to look forward to and at its best price ever, [i]Over The Alps[/i] is an absorbing experience that’s only going to get better from here on out. With new content due next year and two enveloping stories to lose yourself in, it’s time to get yourself to Switzerland this winter, agent, and enjoy journeys that’ll transport you to one of the world’s wintriest and intriguing locations this Holiday!

notes.title: Our major technical update, A Test Of Character, is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gGa4B7V.jpg[/img]

Discover new stories, fight new threats and do your best to stay undercover in this, our first free technical update! 

A Test Of Character includes over 10,000 words of written content, a brand new game feature and a significant overhaul to the way the game works.

We've overhauled the Clues system in both of our current stories, making it more obvious when and what you've done that might lead the Swiss Police to catch you. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ld93eBb.gif[/img]

These Clues are now reported in a revamped Field Report, along with how the Police picked up on them and a better visual representation of how close they are to catching you...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vDDpCzb.gif[/img]

This was in response to a great deal of feedback about the police system, which we were happy to address! We've also tweaked how often and where the police can catch you, with the aim of improving playability.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FitR9HS.jpg[/img]

We've also replaced the confusing system of clues on routes with Complications, our major new feature. These short stories test which stamps you've favoured in the game so far, and can lead to you dropping more Clues...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n1kmG9I.gif[/img]

Each Complication choice comes with a success or a failure story branch. We've added these to routes throughout our two stories, and made visual improvements to our game map to make it easier to use.

This update was a labour of love, as it involved rehauling some complicated systems, some serious gameplay testing and a ton of new written content to integrate with existing words.

We hope you enjoy A Test Of Character as much as we've enjoyed making it! Please let us know what you think and, if you did enjoy it, do leave us a review, as that helps our little games company out a great deal.

notes.title: A Test of Character - Out 27th November!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/ee723268b29b7deb00740d7e22a0e6a092e125a4.jpg[/img]

Greetings, agents.
 
First off, apologies are in order. The [i][b]A Test of Character[/b][/i] update was originally announced for August, but we encountered some unexpected issues in development that pushed the release date back, and back, and back again. In the unpredictable world of game development, it’s a tale as old as time, and I hope you can forgive the delay.
 
We now have a confident release date for the [b]ATOC[/b] update - the 27th of November! Check back on [b][i]Over the Alps[/i][/b] at the end of the month and you’ll discover a total rework of the police pursuit mechanic, an improved footprints and misdirects system, and even a smidge of new narrative content. For a full rundown of the content of the next update, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1227400/announcements/detail/2525905600510731931]check out our previous blog post on the subject.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/9e9d67d57cc38fa6f863c465b866fc8b9a30cb61.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

The discerning among you may have noted that on [i][b]Over the Alps[/b][/i]’ story select screen, there are three Top Secret manila folders, each containing a story. So far, only the first two have been revealed - [b][i]A Case of the Chateaux Vercoli[/i][/b] and [b][i]King of the Mountain[/i][/b].
 
Worry not, agents! The final free story update - the conclusion of this loose espionage trilogy - is well in the works, and will be coming to your various devices in 2021. Keep your ears to the ground - a proper announcement will be flying your way very soon.

notes.title: Live: FuzzyFreaks Streams Over The Alps!
notes.notes:
Join FuzzyFreaks on her full playthrough of Over The Alps, including the new King of the Mountain free expansion. Ask questions in chat, and we'll do our best to respond! notes.title: Over the Alps is Exhibiting at Indie Arena Booth!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/woJfbZH.jpg[/img]

[h2]Exciting developments, agents![/h2]

Starting from the [b]27th of August, Over the Alps [/b]will be exhibiting at the Indie Arena Booth as part of Gamescom 2020. We will be streaming alongside 184 other amazing indie games, all in one online booth! [url=https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2020/games]Browse the full lineup here.[/url] 

As part of the event, our good friend [b]FuzzyFreaks [/b]will be live on our Steam page, so be sure to check out her stream and lend her your support.

There will also be a [b]10% discount[/b] over the course of the event, so tell your OTA-less friends that the 27th onwards is the perfect time to buy.

[h2]Nintendo Switch Version Launches Today[/h2]

In other news, Over the Alps is releasing on [b]Nintendo Switch today[/b] - you can find it on the [url=bit.ly/otaswitch]Nintendo eShop here[/url]. The new release has been adapted to Switch’s touch controls and will work in both docked and handheld mode, meaning keen spies will finally have a gadget they can use in the field.

All updates for the Steam and Apple Arcade versions of the game will also be coming to Switch, with all 15 languages supported. 

[h2]A Test of Character Update Delay[/h2]

The free [b]Test of Character[/b] update, which we announced a few weeks ago, has been pushed back as we iron out some of the kinks. This is a big gameplay overhaul, and we may have under-estimated the amount of time it would take to get ready for release!

You will be the first to know as soon as we have a certain date for the launch. Please accept our apologies, and if you have no idea what we’re talking about, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1227400/view/2525905600510731930]why not check this previous announcement[/url], which explains [b]A Test of Character[/b] and the proposed changes in-depth.

notes.title: Last Days of the Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Just a quick post this time, agents, to let you know that the Summer Sale is coming to an end!

As we showed you in the last update, we at Stave Studios have a veritable feast of upcoming content scheduled, all [b]completely free[/b] for those who already own the game. Here’s the roadmap again, for those who didn’t catch it last time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/e5b3017bdf0f94397b1cad1b582a2f2aba7341af.png[/img]

Our most recent update, [b]King of the Mountain[/b], almost doubled the length of the base game, and we plan to release more like it in future, as well as mechanical updates that refine the core gameplay.

Of course, continuing to provide you with all this new content isn’t easy on our end, especially as each new update is less likely to be covered by mainstream games news outlets. We rely on ongoing sales through Steam to keep the lights on in the meantime! 

And with the Summer Sale ([b]20% off[/b], by the way), this is absolutely the [b]best time to buy Over the Alps while you still can[/b]. So we’re making a final big push to get the sales we need to reach the end of our roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/81e2454675a6388ad4c1613f52c163276e6a7b40.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t bought the game yet, [b]now’s the best time[/b]. Hurry! While digital stocks last!

If you’ve already bought the game, and you’re feeling benevolent, you can still help out - why not [b]leave a review?[/b] Every review we get is massively important in bumping us up the Steam rankings, blessing us with a kind algorithm, and - crucially - putting us in front of more eyes! [b]Visibility[/b] has been our hardest mountain to climb, and we need all the help we can get if we’re going to reach the summit.

Thank you, agents, from the bottom of our hearts. We consider this effort critical to the completion of our mission. Good luck.

notes.title: Upcoming Technical Update: A Test of Character
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/09396affb7e73af98ddc6fdc426f6aa687ae4052.jpg[/img]

We at Stave Studios are pleased to announce that our next major update to [i][b]Over the Alps[/b][/i], titled [b]A TEST OF CHARACTER[/b], will be a total overhaul of the existing “police pursuit” mechanic. As with our last major update, [b]King of the Mountain[/b], this patch will be [b]totally free[/b] for everyone who owns the game.

We’ll go through our in-depth reasoning for making these changes at the end of this update, but first of all, here’s a quick preview of what you can expect!

[h3]OVERCOME UNEXPECTED CHALLENGES THAT TEST YOUR CHARACTER [/h3]
[list]
[*] As you travel the Routes in [i][b]Over the Alps[/b][/i], you now have the chance to encounter [b]COMPLICATIONS [/b]which impede your progress! 
[*] These obstacles must be overcome using one of the [b]character traits[/b] that you’ve been building up over the course of the game. It’s time to start paying attention to your [b]Stamps[/b]!
[*] The higher the [b]Risk Level[/b] of your chosen Route, the more likely you are to find yourself in a spot of bother.
[*] Failure in the [b]Complication[/b] means leaving a [b]Footprint[/b]. The Police will start closing in!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/8373ba3bafaa66d45f5f4a15b056e396920fb578.jpg[/img]

[h3]KEEP TRACK OF THE CLUES YOU LEAVE BEHIND [/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Footprints [/b]in [i][b]Over the Alps[/b][/i] are an abstraction of the clues you’re leaving, which the police can use to track you down. 
[*] In [b]A TEST OF CHARACTER[/b], each of the Footprints is now tracked individually, so you always know [b]exactly how you messed up[/b]. Oops.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/10c1cd4f9988948ca5b0fa530fff07c92d18c648.jpg[/img]

[h3]PEEK AT THE NOTES OF THE POLICEMAN ON YOUR TAIL[/h3]
You can now take a peek at the [b]Police Notes[/b] to see exactly how close they are to catching you, and what they think of this English spy who’s been causing havoc in the peaceful Swiss countryside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/110cbe62582a23a8d213c96d06d7034e31447fb2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Why are we making these changes?[/h2]

(Obligatory note of caution: Everything here is subject to change! We’re still in the process of implementing the new system, and there is extensive playtesting ahead of us. Take the following with a hefty grain of salt.)

After receiving feedback from our players on Steam and Apple Arcade, we felt that the previous implementation of the police pursuit had room for improvement.

Here’s a screenshot of the older system in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/292591fcc5b69be2fade6e374f43edd2423940bb.png[/img]

We found that players struggled to follow what was happening here. The Field Report pops up on screen and vanishes much too quickly, often resulting in a player not having time to process it. 

Even seasoned players still had trouble parsing the relationship between the Route Risk Level, the Footprints, and the police’s position on the tracker. 

Our solution is to introduce clarity by expanding on each of these elements, giving the player more information and (importantly) more time to process what was happening! 

Tracking the [b]Footprints [/b]individually makes it super-clear what clues you left for the Police, and showing the [b]Police Notes[/b] makes it obvious how close they are to catching you. The latter also provides an interesting third-person perspective on the player’s in-game decisions.

By far the greatest gameplay change is the addition of the [b]Complications [/b]to Routes. We chose to add these for several reasons:

[list]
[*] Most importantly, it’s just fun! It adds a nice element of role-playing - your Spy may be better-equipped to deal with some Complications than others, depending on your choices and playstyle. You’ll always know beforehand which Routes test which characteristics, so choosing your Routes now requires some tactical thinking.
[*] It makes the Risk Level more relevant to gameplay. Only riskier Routes threaten to block your progress with a Complication.
[*] It increases the game’s replayability and adds something even for seasoned players to discover. Now there is even more optional content hidden behind many of the different Routes in the game.
[/list]

Here’s a fancy flowchart of what the Spy’s journey down a particularly dangerous Route might look like after the [b]Test of Character [/b]update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/9e9d67d57cc38fa6f863c465b866fc8b9a30cb61.png[/img]

[b]Good luck, agents![/b] It looks like your job just got a little more… complicated.

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

The [b]Test of Character[/b] update is just one step in our dastardly long-term plan to provide you with more of the game you’ve already bought. Here’s a roadmap showing our planned upcoming content, and remember, [b]all of this is free[/b]:

[url=https://overthealpsgame.com/roadmap][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/e5b3017bdf0f94397b1cad1b582a2f2aba7341af.png[/img][/url]

What’s behind those intriguing redactions, you ask? Well, that’s a top-secret matter of national security, and a topic for another post. But I can assure you, the gears are turning. Ink is being spilled.

[b]Over the Alps is not over yet.[/b]

PS: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227400/Over_the_Alps/]Over the Alps is in the Steam summer sale! You can grab yourself a copy now for 20% off.[/url]

notes.title: King of the Mountain: Free Full-length Story Update to Over the Alps, Out Now!
notes.notes:
The time has come, agent.

King of the Mountain, our new free full-length story update to Over the Alps, is being released today. Yes, you’re hearing that correctly, agent. It’s completely free for anyone who owns the original game, whether that be on Steam or on Apple Arcade.

King of the Mountain is set a year earlier than Over the Alps, in 1938, with war only a distant storm on the horizon. The intelligence services of Britain and Germany are arranging their pieces on the chessboard of Europe. 

Against this backdrop, you are playing as Annie Taylor, a British spy who has been reluctantly called away from Paris to attend the Swiss Grand Prix in Bern. She ends up in over her head, tangling with enemy Nazi agents, exchanging gunfire with Swiss yokels, and eventually being forced to take part in the Grand Prix herself...

For those who have played the original game, you may see some familiar places… and encounter some familiar faces. And if you haven’t downloaded the original Over the Alps yet, now’s the perfect time - you’ll get double the bang for your proverbial buck! Two stories for the price of one, and a third in the pipeline!

Check it out now - we hope you enjoy it! And don’t go falling into any lakes, you’ll catch your death...

notes.notes:
Greetings agents,
                
This is a brief communiqué to all our most trusted operatives. Usually we tell you to burn this kind of thing after reading, but on this one instance, we'd like you to spread the word as wide as possible:

[b]King of the Mountain is releasing 12th June![/b]

[previewyoutube=uOCmRq1biwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]King of the Mountain[/b] is a [b]free[/b] new story expansion for [b]Over the Alps[/b].
                                      
The story takes place a year earlier than [b]Over the Alps[/b], in August 1938. Some say war is on the horizon… You will play as Annie Taylor, a British spy called away from the comforts of Paris to tackle an urgent assignment in Bern. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/knH2Wxz.gif[/img]

Over the course of your mission, you will attempt to infiltrate the Swiss Grand Prix, tangle with Nazis along the way, and you may end up going off the map entirely...
    
We've been working pretty hard on this one, and we're excited to finally release the next instalment in the [b]Over the Alps[/b] anthology!

notes.title: King of the Mountain, coming this Summer!
notes.notes:
Welcome back, agent. It’s been too long.

This is a brief communiqué to let all our most trusted operatives know that the story of Over the Alps is not over yet. 

[previewyoutube=uOCmRq1biwU;full][/previewyoutube]

This major free update will release over the summer and consist of an entire new self-contained story set in the same continuity as Over the Alps, featuring a whole new character!
[list]
[*] The story takes place a year earlier than Over the Alps, in August 1938. Some say war is on the horizon…
[*] Play as Annie Taylor, a British spy who has been called away from the comforts of Paris to deal with an urgent matter in Bern. 
[*] Attempt to infiltrate the Swiss Grand Prix! 
[*] Tangle with Nazis! 
[*] Get shot at! Sometimes for good reason!
[*] Fall into a lake. Push other people into lakes. The lakes are off the charts.
[*] You may even encounter some familiar faces along the way…
[/list]
Watch this space - a release date is forthcoming.

notes.title: Over The Alps, a WWII spy adventure, is out today
notes.notes:
It’s World War II, the sequel nobody wanted, and the Swiss police are on your tail. That’s likely no good even in 2020, but in 1939 it’s especially inadvisable as you’re a spy trying very hard to stay undercover. Over The Alps is out today, taking you back to a colorful version of the war styled like a jaunty antique postcard collection.

(more…)
